desc: The Orion Compact brings the classic Weatherby over-under design to smaller-statured shooters with a refined 20-gauge configuration. This shotgun features a shorter length of pull, offering improved comfort and control for smaller frames while delivering the same trusted Weatherby performance. Crafted for a perfect balance between tradition and innovation, the Orion Compact ensures accuracy, durability, and ease of handling, making it the ideal choice for those who want the ultimate shotgun experience without compromise. Whether on the range or in the field, this compact over-under is ready for action.
